rules: No refitting of either mapping constant or tolerance. All points and disagreements must be retained.
Prepare copies by replacing only exact XML field byte spans; never reserialize the vendor workspace. Verify SI readbacks and dataset freshness before accepting capture.
Stop on errors, warnings, timeout or unexpected workspace. No blind rerun; reserve may only be used after a specific diagnosed setup repair.
Save results to unique new files, close each dedicated copy, reopen pristine baseline without analysis. Do not exit the user-owned SystemVue instance.

A successful bounded transfer allows a separately named opt-in calibrated C++ model. Preserve LegacyPointDerivativeAmPm and its original meaning. No inference of multitone, frequency-dependent phase or vendor internal constant derivation.
